characters.name: Rovan Vey
characters.title: Duke
characters.status: A duke in name only at the opening
characters.rise_to_power: Protected other cities and their ships from pirates.
characters.initial_condition: Depleted fleet, few resources, unable to pay his soldiers despite their sacrifices.
characters.motivation: Resents wealthy rulers who benefited from his protection and declares he will define his own future and take what is his.
characters.key_quote: I will define my own future. We sail for Auric Reach. I will take what is mine.

military.recruitment: Funded and equipped from seized resources; veterans drill recruits

characters.exclusive_knowledge: Secret Type C crafting knowledge gained through experience

visual_concept.appearance: Adult man, black hair with silver streak, short dark beard, navy officer coat with bronze shoulder armour, muted red scarf

characters.uniform_standard: Veymarch military base-layer cloth, capes and tabards are crimson red; bronze armour stays bronze, and Type C armour stays silver. Rovan’s navy outer officer coat and the general’s olive outer coat remain distinct.

characters.name: General Grievous
characters.role: Rovan’s right-hand man
characters.relationship_to_rovan: Shares the fleet accounts, hears his frustration, and accompanies his seizure and campaign.

visual_concept.status: provisional project artwork, not established species or biography
visual_concept.appearance: Older bald human officer with a grey moustache, dark olive coat and bronze epaulettes

characters.uniform_standard: Veymarch military base-layer cloth, capes and tabards are crimson red; bronze armour stays bronze, and Type C armour stays silver. Rovan’s navy outer officer coat and the general’s olive outer coat remain distinct.

characters.name: Rovan’s five honour-guard captains

equipment.armour_construction: Practical man-made brushed silver with tool marks and restrained machined details; sealed continuous coverage with no joints or gaps.
equipment.armour_detail: Brushed silver shells with narrow aged brass edging, small fittings and chased geometric details. Crimson enamel badges show Veymarch’s silver broken shield and eight-point star.

characters.mobility: Drift along magnetic fields and leap between ships
characters.uniform_standard: Continuous silver coverage with no joints or gaps. Crimson capes, sashes and tabards are worn over the sealed armour; cloth is never a gap in the metal.

characters.name: Ferdinand
characters.title: Duke
characters.role: Duke Ferdinand, ruler of Auric Reach; confers with his barons and surrenders Oram under bombardment.
characters.current_action: Surrenders the city of Oram after conferring with the barons on page22.

visual_concept.status: Existing shadowed ruler is now named Duke Ferdinand; retain the earlier human face, gold/navy wardrobe and court setting.
visual_concept.appearance: Middle-aged human man with swept-back dark hair greying at temples, short dark beard and moustache, lined face, heavy gold mantle and ceremonial chain over navy coat embroidered in gold. Not Rovan and not Admiral Joseph; no monocle. Looks exhausted and cornered during the council.

characters.name: The schooner courier
characters.role: Unnamed Veymarch messenger; first warns Rovan of the three approaching Bastions and later carries Rovan’s demand to Oram on page22.

visual_concept.appearance: Young adult human messenger with short brown hair, flying goggles pushed onto forehead, worn bronze flight jacket over a crimson base layer; no silver armour.

characters.uniform_standard: Practical bronze and leather flight gear over crimson cloth; Veymarch affiliation.

characters.name: The conquered city’s onlookers
characters.role: Unnamed civilian inhabitants who watch the Argonaut depart and assume Rovan will lose.

visual_concept.appearance: A small mixed group of adult civilians in plain worn work coats, wool scarves and everyday clothes; no military uniforms or silver armour.

characters.name: Rovan’s engineers
characters.role: The engineers and dockworkers who refit the Argonaut in fourteen days using the new resources.

visual_concept.appearance: Chief engineer: middle-aged human woman, grey hair tied back, round goggles on forehead, crimson work shirt, brown leather apron, practical gloves. Other engineers wear simple workshop clothes, no silver armour.

characters.name: Admiral Joseph
characters.title: Admiral
characters.role: Arrogant Auric Reach fleet commander pursuing Rovan with three Bastions.
characters.motivation: Greed: he expects a duchy of his own if he defeats Rovan. This is his ambition, not an established promise by the ruler.
characters.conduct: Ignores his sailors’ warnings about the strong magnetic fields and difficult rock passages.

visual_concept.appearance: Broad, clean-shaven middle-aged human officer with a square jaw, slicked-back iron-grey hair, thick grey eyebrows, a brass monocle over his right eye and a high-collared navy uniform with ornate gold epaulettes. NOT bald, no beard, distinct from Rovan and Grievous.

characters.uniform_standard: Auric Reach navy coat and gold trim; no crimson Veymarch clothing.
characters.status: Defeated and taken prisoner; sentenced by Rovan to be thrown overboard for his arrogant, reckless command.
characters.sentence_execution: Not depicted; page19 shows pronouncement and escort toward the rail.

characters.name: Auric Reach sailors
characters.role: Unnamed crew who warn Admiral Joseph that the Shattered Plains will break their formation.

visual_concept.appearance: Practical human deck crew in worn navy work jackets, muted gold piping and simple caps. No ceremonial officer epaulettes or silver armour.

characters.latest_status: Crews lay down their weapons and surrender to Rovan on page19.

characters.name: The Stormlance
characters.title: The Stormlance
characters.role: One of Rovan’s five silver honour-guard captains, identified by title rather than a personal name.

equipment.armour_protection: Impervious to weapons; no joints or gaps.

characters.name: Veymarch commandos
characters.role: Bronze-armoured troops who wait on a floating rock and board Serenity with the Stormlance and Windblade.

visual_concept.appearance: Practical bronze helmets and armour over crimson work tunics, compact Tesla guns, grapnels and tethered boarding lines. Never silver Type C.

characters.name: Mara Voss
characters.title: Captain

visual_concept.appearance: Brown-skinned human woman in her thirties, dark hair in one long braid, composed direct gaze, navy naval coat over crimson shirt, small bronze epaulettes and practical belt. No silver armour.

characters.role: Newly appointed prize-crew naval captain of Josephine. A regular officer, distinct from the five silver honour-guard captains.
characters.uniform_standard: Navy officer coat over crimson cloth, restrained bronze fittings. Ordinary naval officer, not a new Type C armour set.

characters.name: Idris Vale
characters.title: Captain

visual_concept.appearance: Tall dark-skinned human man, close-cropped black curls, short full black beard, navy naval coat with crimson collar and rolled cuffs, modest bronze fittings. No silver armour.

characters.role: Newly appointed prize-crew naval captain of Serenity. A regular officer, distinct from the five silver honour-guard captains.
characters.uniform_standard: Navy officer coat over crimson cloth, restrained bronze fittings. Ordinary naval officer, not a new Type C armour set.

characters.name: Tomas Kest
characters.title: Captain

visual_concept.appearance: Stocky light-tan-skinned human man, straight cropped black hair with grey temples, clean-shaven face, square brass-framed spectacles, navy naval coat over crimson and practical leather gloves. No monocle or silver armour.

characters.role: Newly appointed prize-crew naval captain of Serendipity. A regular officer, distinct from the five silver honour-guard captains.
characters.uniform_standard: Navy officer coat over crimson cloth, restrained bronze fittings. Ordinary naval officer, not a new Type C armour set.

characters.name: New Frontier volunteers
characters.role: People from Auric Reach and Rovan’s home duchy who come to join him after seeing his captured fleet.

visual_concept.appearance: A varied crowd of human women and men in ordinary travelling clothes and work coats, carrying small packs and lining up to enlist. Recruits are not prisoners; no silver armour.

characters.name: Civilians of Oram
characters.role: People of the richest and largest city, who have always felt safe and panic as the siege begins.

visual_concept.appearance: Human civilians of varied ages and backgrounds in practical, prosperous city clothes: market workers, families and merchants. Fear, confusion and urgent movement; no silver armour. No graphic injuries.

characters.name: Barons of Auric Reach
characters.role: The barons confer with Duke Ferdinand during the bombardment of Oram, with no choice but to surrender the city. Individual names are not established. The bald grey-bearded elder is exiled on page23; the other two barons are not shown exiled.

visual_concept.appearance: Three adult human nobles of varied ages in individual navy court coats with restrained gold trim; one older silver-haired woman, one bald bearded man, one younger dark-haired man. Distinct from the duke and from Admiral Joseph. Worried expressions, ordinary court dress, no Type C armour.

characters.name: The elder baron
characters.title: Baron
characters.role: The older bald, grey-bearded man among Ferdinand’s three barons. Rovan exiles him on page23. Not Ferdinand or Admiral Joseph.

visual_concept.appearance: Older bald human man with full short grey beard, heavy brows, navy court coat with gold trim and chain; same bald baron from Ferdinand’s council. Carries a modest travelling case on departure, no armour or monocle.

characters.name: Oram’s new council delegates
characters.role: Dockworkers and farmers invited into Rovan’s first attempts at a fairer local government. Not proof that reform has succeeded.

visual_concept.appearance: One middle-aged human woman representing dockworkers in a worn dark work jacket and practical braid; one older human farmer with weathered skin in a plain linen shirt and brown waistcoat. Ordinary people, no noble chains or military armour.

characters.name: Ironveil advance patrol
characters.role: A small patrol moves toward Auric Reach’s undefended outlying mining fragments on page24. No new capital ship count established.

visual_concept.appearance: Ordinary human patrol crew in steel-grey coats with silver fittings; no Type C armour. One small bronze mechanical schooner, steel-coloured house standard bearing canonical silver hammer/anvil.

characters.name: Glassmere advance party
characters.role: An armed trading expedition moves into an exposed Auric outer mooring on page24 while Rovan struggles to govern. No wider annexation outcome established.

visual_concept.appearance: Human merchant guards in dark teal working coats, ordinary bronze equipment, canonical cyan Glassmere banner. Small mechanical trading Zeppelin, not a capital ship.
